Refusal beats --lane

An installer, .pkg/.dmg or hdiutil in argv is refused on every lane, no
override; --lane headless can't downgrade a GUI verdict. Nothing runs; the
result is errored.
Source: src/cli/api.ts, src/router/index.ts
No fallback to your display

No Docker or helper session → skipped, exit 69, never your screen. The
container drops DISPLAY; sessiond checks peer uid and refuses input when
on the console.
Source: src/lanes/container/index.ts, native/sessiond/Input.swift

Admission before queueing

POST /v1/tasks re-checks the caller after reading the body,
then GUI gate, capacity, credit; a repeated idempotency key
replays. GET ?wait= holds until the task ends.
Source: cloud/src/api/app.ts
Acknowledged is not yet durable

Writes are acked from memory; plane.json is rewritten
atomically every 2 s if changed and on SIGTERM, so a crash
can lose ~2 s of acked work.

Claims, heartbeats, requeue

Claim long-polls ≤25 s. Unstarted 20 s after claim → requeue
(max 3 tries); box silent 2 min → running task fails, not rerun.
Heartbeat (15 s) delivers cancels.
Source: cloud/src/core/queue.ts, cloud/src/core/store.ts
Guarded claim, reset before the next

A slot claims only while the pf LAN guard checks out (fails
closed). Before its next claim it is reset: processes killed,
home wiped, account remade with a new uid.
Source: src/fleet/lan-guard.ts, src/fleet/reset.ts

The key stays on the plane

The customer's Anthropic key stays in plane memory for one
run; the slot gets an omt_ token. The proxy checks model,
step budget and max_tokens; no streaming.
Source: cloud/src/api/agent-routes.ts
Op relay and answer retries

Ops run concurrently as the slot user; each poll reports
room. An answer is resent with backoff until the plane takes
it, and gets one try once closing.
Source: src/fleet/sandbox.ts
